from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e4df7867.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = set()
    # A complete monochrome row or column in the line color is the marker.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            color = row[0]
            if any(cell != color for line in grid for cell in line):
                marked.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1:
            color = col[0]
            if any(grid[r][j] != color for r in range(h) for j in range(w)):
                marked.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r, c in marked:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(source)
